contract.task: Estimate oral temperature measured in monitor mode from facial infrared measurements and environment information.
contract.context: device identifies FLIR or ICI. Facial fields ending _mean are means across available image rounds, in Celsius: right/left canthus maxima and averages; RC/LC eye-corner regions; RCC/LCC small eye-corner regions; canthi extended eye region; FH forehead regions; T_Max face maximum; OR mouth-region infrared readings. T_offset_mean is the blackbody correction offset. Gender/Age/Ethnicity are categories; T_atm: Celsius; Humidity: percent; Distance: metres. Both oral-thermometer fields are excluded from input; infrared mouth-region readings are distinct from oral thermometer labels.
contract.split: group_by_SubjectID across both devices; demographic range limited

grouping_rule: Known semantic groups unioned with identical prepared inputs; group_id does not prove independence.
missing_policy: No target imputation; invalid/missing targets excluded. Missing features remain null. Explicit invalid-ratio repairs audited.
split_policy: unassigned; use contract split guidance; dataset-family holdouts decided before training

citation_paper.title: Infrared Thermography for Measuring Elevated Body Temperature: Clinical Accuracy, Calibration, and Evaluation
citation_paper.authors: Quanzeng Wang, Yangling Zhou, Pejman Ghassemi, David McBride, J. Casamento, T. Pfefer

quality_findings.detail: Original release: FLIR 1020 + ICI 1009 device records from 1026 subjects, not 2029 independent people. This extends the UCI 1020-row subset.
26 facial temperature descriptors plus blackbody offset averaged over available rounds. All-round-missing remains null. Both oral thermometer readings, ID, Time, Date and Cosmetics excluded.
Monitor-mode labels match for every subject measured on both devices. Other oral target never enters input.
Different labels for identical prepared inputs are retained, not averaged (except the explicitly defined SGEMM mean target).
Store one identical task/input/label and retain every source occurrence in source_refs/duplicate_count.
Conservative decimal precision cap; original source files unchanged. All changes and old/new IDs retained in numeric_precision_changes.jsonl.gz.

source_values_policy: Original numeric labels except documented arithmetic mean for SGEMM; no learned scaling, clipping or target log transform. Prepared numeric values now follow significant_digits_12_v1; exact originals remain in raw and the versioned history.

numeric_precision.rule: Non-integral finite floats rounded to at most 12 significant decimal digits; integers, null and strings unchanged; no fixed decimal-place rounding or clipping.

prepared_profile_scope: Final normalized, eligible, deduplicated output records. Raw profile retains the original source-table scope.
distribution_format: UTF-8 JSON Lines, gzip compressed, at most 100000 records per shard
